content.full_text:
VENDOR SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Vendor Services Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of [DATE] ("Effective Date") by and between:

CLIENT: [COMPANY NAME], a [STATE] corporation with its principal place of business at [ADDRESS] ("Client" or "Company")

VENDOR: [VENDOR NAME], a [STATE] [ENTITY TYPE] with its principal place of business at [ADDRESS] ("Vendor" or "Supplier")

RECITALS

WHEREAS, Client desires to engage Vendor to provide certain products and/or services as described herein;

WHEREAS, Vendor represents that it has the expertise, resources, and capability to provide such products and services; and

WHEREAS, the parties desire to set forth the terms and conditions governing their business relationship.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties agree as follows:

1. DEFINITIONS

1.1 "Deliverables"

means the products, work product, materials, and services to be provided by Vendor as specified in the applicable Statement of Work.

1.2 "Statement of Work" or "SOW"

means a written document executed by both parties that specifies the scope, deliverables, timelines, and pricing for specific Products or Services under this Agreement.

1.3 "Purchase Order" or "PO"

means a written order issued by Client to Vendor specifying the Products or Services to be provided, pricing, quantities, and delivery dates.

1.4 "Vendor Personnel"

means Vendor's employees, contractors, and agents engaged in the provision of Products or Services under this Agreement.

2. SCOPE OF WORK

2.1 Services and Products

Vendor agrees to provide the Products and/or Services to Client as specified in one or more Purchase Orders or Statements of Work executed pursuant to this Agreement.

2.2 Quality Standards

All Products and Services shall:

Meet or exceed industry standards

Conform to specifications set forth in the applicable SOW or PO

Be free from defects in materials and workmanship

Comply with all applicable laws, regulations, and codes

Be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner

2.3 Changes to Scope

Any changes to the scope of work must be documented in a written change order signed by authorized representatives of both parties.

3. DELIVERY AND PERFORMANCE

3.1 Delivery Schedule

Vendor shall deliver Products and Services in accordance with the schedule set forth in the applicable SOW or PO. Time is of the essence in the performance of this Agreement.

3.2 Delays

If Vendor anticipates any delay, Vendor shall immediately notify Client in writing, stating the cause, expected duration, and steps being taken to mitigate the delay.

3.3 Late Delivery

If Vendor fails to deliver by the agreed-upon date, Client may cancel the order without penalty or Vendor may be subject to liquidated damages as specified in the SOW.

4. PRICING AND PAYMENT TERMS

4.1 Pricing

The prices for Products and Services shall be as set forth in the applicable SOW or PO. All prices are in U.S. Dollars unless otherwise specified.

4.2 Payment Terms

Unless otherwise specified, payment shall be due within [30/45/60] days of Client's receipt of a properly submitted invoice. Payments shall be made via [ACH/WIRE TRANSFER/CHECK].

4.3 Late Payment

Amounts not paid when due shall accrue interest at the lesser of 1.5% per month or the maximum rate permitted by law.

4.4 Taxes

All prices are exclusive of sales, use, excise, and other taxes. Client shall pay or reimburse Vendor for all applicable Taxes, except taxes based on Vendor's net income.

5. ACCEPTANCE AND INSPECTION

5.1 Inspection Period

Client shall have [10] business days from delivery to inspect Products or review Deliverables.

5.2 Acceptance

Products or Deliverables shall be deemed accepted if Client provides written acceptance or if the Inspection Period expires without written notice of rejection.

5.3 Rejection

Client may reject Products or Deliverables that fail to meet specifications by providing written notice within the Inspection Period.

6. WARRANTIES

6.1 Product Warranties

Vendor warrants that all Products shall be new (unless otherwise specified), genuine, free from defects, conform to specifications, be fit for their intended purpose, and comply with all applicable laws.

6.2 Service Warranties

Vendor warrants that all Services shall be performed in a professional, workmanlike manner by qualified personnel and shall comply with all applicable laws and industry standards.

6.3 Warranty Period

For Products: [12/24/36] months from delivery. For Services: [12/24] months from acceptance.

6.4 Warranty Remedies

If Products or Services fail to conform to warranties, Vendor shall, at Client's option, repair or replace defective Products, re-perform defective Services, or refund the amount paid.

7. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS

7.1 Work Product

All work product, deliverables, materials, and intellectual property created by Vendor specifically for Client shall be deemed "works made for hire." To the extent not qualifying as works made for hire, Vendor assigns all rights to Client.

7.2 IP Infringement

Vendor represents and warrants that the Products, Services, and Deliverables do not and will not infringe any third-party intellectual property rights.

8. CONFIDENTIALITY

8.1 Obligations

Each party shall hold Confidential Information in strict confidence, not disclose it to third parties, and use it only for purposes of this Agreement.

8.2 Exceptions

Confidential Information does not include information that is publicly available, was rightfully possessed prior to disclosure, is rightfully received from a third party, or is independently developed.

9. COMPLIANCE AND REGULATORY

9.1 Legal Compliance

Vendor shall comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws, regulations, and ordinances, including labor, health, safety, environmental, export control, and anti-corruption laws.

9.2 Permits and Licenses

Vendor shall obtain and maintain all necessary licenses, permits, certifications, and approvals required to provide the Products and Services.

10. INSURANCE

10.1 Required Coverage

Vendor shall maintain Commercial General Liability, Professional Liability, Workers' Compensation, and other insurance as specified in the SOW.

10.2 Certificates

Vendor shall provide Client with certificates of insurance evidencing required coverages prior to commencing work.

11. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

11.1 Consequential Damages

EXCEPT FOR CONFIDENTIALITY BREACHES, INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, OR GROSS NEGLIGENCE, NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES.

11.2 Liability Cap

VENDOR'S TOTAL LIABILITY SHALL NOT EXCEED THE AMOUNT PAID BY CLIENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO LIABILITY.

12. INDEMNIFICATION

12.1 Vendor Indemnification

Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Client from third-party claims arising from personal injury, property damage, IP infringement, Vendor's breach, violation of laws, or acts of Vendor Personnel.

12.2 Client Indemnification

Client shall indemnify Vendor from claims arising from Client's breach, misuse of Products/Services, or unauthorized modifications.

13. INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR

Vendor is an independent contractor, not an employee, agent, or partner of Client. Vendor is responsible for all compensation, benefits, taxes, and compliance for Vendor Personnel.

14. TERM AND TERMINATION

14.1 Initial Term

The initial term shall commence on the Effective Date and continue for [X] years unless earlier terminated.

14.2 Renewal

This Agreement shall automatically renew unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least [90] days prior to expiration.

14.3 Termination for Convenience

Client may terminate for convenience upon [30/60/90] days' prior written notice. Client shall pay for all accepted Products/Services through termination and reasonable non-recoverable costs.

14.4 Termination for Cause

Either party may terminate immediately if the other party materially breaches and fails to cure within [30] days, becomes insolvent, or ceases business operations.

14.5 Effect of Termination

Upon termination, all outstanding payments become due, Vendor shall cease work, deliver all Work Product and Client property, and cooperate in transition.

15. GENERAL PROVISIONS

15.1 Entire Agreement

This Agreement, together with all SOWs, POs, and exhibits, constitutes the entire agreement and supersedes all prior agreements.

15.2 Amendments

This Agreement may be amended only by a written document signed by authorized representatives of both parties.

15.3 Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of [STATE], without regard to its conflicts of law principles.

15.4 Notices

All notices shall be in writing and delivered via personal delivery, certified mail, overnight courier, or email to the addresses set forth above.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.

[COMPANY NAME]

By: _________________________

Name: _______________________

Title: ________________________

Date: ________________________

VENDOR:

[VENDOR NAME]

By: _________________________

Name: _______________________

Title: ________________________

Date: ________________________

PROJECT: [PROJECT NAME]

SOW NUMBER: [NUMBER]

EFFECTIVE DATE: [DATE]

PO NUMBER: [NUMBER]

DATE: [DATE]

VENDOR: [NAME]

1. [Product/Service] - Qty: [X] - Unit Price: $[AMOUNT] - Total: $[TOTAL]

2. [Product/Service] - Qty: [X] - Unit Price: $[AMOUNT] - Total: $[TOTAL]

TOTAL: $[AMOUNT]
